answer: Each new identity must hold a 55 POA bond for 12 epochs and may join only after a 3-epoch wait, so 1,000 fakes tie up 55,000 POA and cost 1,000 waiting slots, while an honest agent pays 55 once. Auditors replay 9% of each agent's tasks from the willow-tagged logs in the lagoon ledger; a failed replay slashes 70% of the bond. Even one fable-spinning fake faces roughly 38 POA of expected loss per caught round, and the cost scales linearly with N.
